what: Kunstnerviften (the Artists' Fan), Kristiania (Oslo), 1898. A brisé fan of eighteen painted wooden sticks with a black lacquered guard and a brass bail; each stick painted by a different artist (Gerhard Munthe, Jacob Bratland, Fredrik Kolstø, Karl Uchermann, Otto Sinding, Asta Nørregaard, Thorolf Holmboe, Elisabeth Sinding, Christian Skredsvig, Christian Krohg, Amaldus Nielsen, Gustav Lærum, Carl Sundt-Hansen, Axel Ender, Severin Segelcke, Hans Gude, Hans Heyerdahl, Eilif Peterssen), with a peacock painted across the gorge.
source: Nasjonalmuseet for kunst, arkitektur og design, Oslo, NG.M.04483; the museum's photograph via Wikimedia Commons
